verdict.rationale: Composio documents scoping what an agent can reach. Sessions can be limited to specific toolkits, and MCP servers or URLs can be created that serve only an explicit allowed_tools list, giving the agent least-privilege tool access instead of the default full catalog. The evidence does not show issuing scoped API keys or tokens as credentials in their own right; scoping lives in session and server configuration. missing for 10: documented scoped or least-privilege API keys for agents, per-credential permission scopes (e.g. OAuth scope restriction), credential expiry and revocation controls, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: To restrict the set, pass `toolkits` when you create the session.
